required.purpose: SDXL refiner pass for detail at high resolution

recommended.purpose: Reference / multi-control union model — locks composition to your Europe map reference
recommended.compat_note: Union ControlNet supports multiple control types in one file. Use ComfyUI-Advanced-ControlNet or ControlNetApply nodes. For pure image-reference style transfer, also install IP-Adapter (see compatibility.md).

recommended.purpose: Style/blur Control-LLLite — keeps palette and shading consistent across tiles
recommended.compat_note: Lightweight Control-LLLite model. Pairs well with tile ControlNet for cohesive large-map output.

recommended.purpose: Pixel art style LoRA for SDXL
recommended.compat_note: Civitai download — may require browser or API token if link fails. Manual: https://civitai.com/models/120096/pixel-art-xl
